title: Checkpoint lineage row
description: One row of governance/CHECKPOINT_LINEAGE.csv. INTERPRETATION layer of the 3-layer spine (see governance/README.md): ckpt provenance derived from on-disk hashes/metadata + DECISIONS.md/STATUS.md/launcher scripts. Many provenance fields were NEVER persisted at train time and are unrecoverable from docs; those carry the literal sentinel 'unknown@train' (a key Phase-B-instrumentation gap, NOT a missing value). Epoch IDs reference governance/EVIDENCE_EPOCHS.md.

ckpt_id.description: Short stable id for the checkpoint (e.g. iter_11, stage_b_iter_01, residual).

path.description: Absolute path on disk (local checkpoints/ or the CIFS share /mnt/c/carc-shared/).

exists.description: Whether the .pt was present on disk at registry-build time (2026-06-07).

sha256.description: Full 64-hex sha256sum of the .pt if it exists, else 'MISSING'.

parent_ckpt.description: warm-from checkpoint id/path. RECOVERED from per-iter metrics.json warm_from / launcher WARM default / DECISIONS. 'none' = trained from scratch on warmstart data.

code_commit.description: Best-effort git commit the training code ran at. NOT persisted in the ckpt dict; 'unknown@train' unless pinned by a DECISIONS entry or launcher commit.

dirty.description: Whether the working tree was dirty at train time. Never persisted -> 'unknown@train'.

arch.description: Architecture summary from the ckpt metadata dict: n_filters x n_blocks, value_global_pool, n_scalar_features. Fields absent from older ckpt dicts are 'unknown@train' inside the string.

ruleset.description: Rule scope of the TRAINING self-play. 'river+base' (pre-2026-06-02 lineage) or 'base-only' (post river-drop). Recovered from DECISIONS 2026-06-02 + lineage dates.

known_bug_epoch.description: Comma-joined evidence-epoch IDs whose fix the checkpoint's TRAINING predates (it carries that defect). E.g. a ckpt trained before 2026-05-29 carries E1-farmbug. See governance/EVIDENCE_EPOCHS.md. 'none-known' if trained after all data-side fixes.

train_command.description: Best-effort. Full CLI never persisted; recovered launcher + key knobs (sims, c_puct, cap, games, epochs) where derivable, else 'unknown@train'.

seed_ranges.description: Self-play seed range(s). Not persisted in the ckpt -> 'unknown@train' unless a DECISIONS/STATUS note pins it.

dataset_files_hashes.description: Hashes of the self-play .npz training set. NEVER persisted -> 'unknown@train' (a Phase-B instrumentation gap).

replay_iters.description: Replay-buffer window (which prior iters' data were mixed in). Recovered from metrics.json window/buffer_files where present, else 'unknown@train'.

policy_target.description: Policy training target (MCTS visit distribution). Best-effort; 'unknown@train' if not recoverable.

value_target.description: Value training target: wl | score_diff | search_value | residual. Recovered from DECISIONS/STATUS/launcher; 'unknown@train' otherwise.

loss_weights.description: policy/value/own loss weights. Partly recoverable (value_loss_weight from launchers); 'unknown@train' for the rest.

aux_heads.description: Auxiliary heads (e.g. ownership). Best-effort from arch metadata; 'unknown@train' if unclear.

selfplay_leaf.description: Leaf evaluator used during the self-play that generated this ckpt's training data: v1 | v2_7 | v2_7+residual. Recovered from DECISIONS; 'unknown@train' for ambiguous eras.

residual_or_value_active.description: Whether a learned value head / residual was active in the self-play leaf (value-blend lambda or residual_scale > 0). Recovered from DECISIONS/STATUS.

gating_result.description: The gate/eval result that promoted this ckpt (elo vs reference). Best-effort from DECISIONS/results.csv; 'unknown@train' if never gated as a unit.

associated_clean_evals.description: cleaneval_* exp_ids in experiments/results.csv that measured this ckpt on the clean ruler. 'none' if not clean-evaluated.

status.description: active = a current candidate; historical = a real prior champion kept for reference; superseded = replaced by a strictly-better ckpt; quarantined = epoch-invalid, do not use for strength claims.

notes.description: Free-text caveats: epoch membership, lineage role, why this status.
